about: WPCS security findings on the shipped verifier's src/, reviewed by Maurice on 2026-09-26 (notes/m5-packaging.md); src/Cli no longer ships since 2026-09-27 (SPEC-006 amendment 4); reviewed again for v0.2.4 on 2026-09-27 (SPEC-006 amendment 5: eight ExceptionNotEscaped findings in two new exception messages) and for v0.2.5 the same day (SPEC-006 amendment 7: five more, in four new exception messages), for v0.2.6 on 2026-09-28 (SPEC-006 amendment 8: one more base64_decode, a public key read as DER), for v0.2.7 on 2026-09-30 (SPEC-006 amendment 9: fread 6 to 2, the reads now go through one helper), and for v0.2.8 the same day (SPEC-006 amendment 10: thirteen more ExceptionNotEscaped, in six new exception messages in Hash/BmffHashCheck.php), and for v0.2.9 on 2026-10-02 (src/ byte for byte v0.2.8's, so the counts stand), and for v0.3.0 on 2026-10-05 (SPEC-006 amendment 11: 61 more ExceptionNotEscaped, in the new RIFF and ID3 readers and the RSA-PSS key rewrite, and one more base64_encode, a public key built as PEM), and for v0.4.0 on 2026-10-06 (SPEC-006 amendment 12: 26 more ExceptionNotEscaped, 23 in the new GIF reader and one each where four readers rethrow with withStoreReached(), one fewer in the RIFF reader), and for v0.5.0 on 2026-10-07 (SPEC-006 amendment 13: 23 more ExceptionNotEscaped and two more fread, all in the new plain-text reader). The release test fails on a new sniff or a higher count. Update only after a review, with the verifier version.
